channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kevin Porter | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kevin Porter from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Kevin Porter
item.description:
Doc Rivers, on Kevin Porter Jr.:

“He’s not gonna play anytime soon, I can tell you that. But we don’t know how long he will be out.”

Doc Rivers on Kevin Porter, Jan 21, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kevin Porter
item.description:
“Can I also make an excuse that's human nature when [Kevin Porter Jr.] goes down and myself goes down, it's human nature to think that you got to carry a load. ... Maybe it's a scoring load, maybe you got to make plays, maybe you think it is your opportunity to get more shots. ... But that's not how you win games. That's not how you build culture.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kevin Porter, Nov 29, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Kevin Porter
item.description:
Doc Rivers, on Kevin Porter Jr.:

“He's still out. He's going to be out for a bit still... Imean, obviously, he's key for us, one of our big keys. We're not going to rush him because we don't want this thing to become chronic. It was a bad turn and so we're just gonna be patient.”

Doc Rivers on Kevin Porter, Oct 28, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kevin Porter
item.description:
Tomer Azarly:Tyronn Lue on if Kevin Porter Jr. is a rotation player for the Clippers:

“He definitely can make an impact. You don't get paid $20 million a year in Houston if you can't play. He's a great talent. It's gonna be my job to make sure we get the best out of him. He can score the basketball, he can make plays, and I'm gonna stay on him and coach him hard. He’s a great talent. For us to have success, he's gonna be a big part of that, so I'm excited for him and the opportunity to coach him.”

Tyronn Lue on Kevin Porter, Sep 26, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Kevin Porter
item.description:
Adam Spolane:More Silas on Kevin Porter Jr:

“We knew he had a past before he came here, but we hold everybody accountable to what they do. He crossed the line and he'll be back, and we'll still love him, and we'll still grow with him and everything will be ok.”

Stephen Silas on Kevin Porter, Jan 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @AdamSpolane.

item.title: Christian Wood on Kevin Porter, Jalen Green
item.description:
Wood told ESPN on Friday.

“We've always stayed together and always had that team chemistry. We know that we're better than a 1-16 record and better than what we were showing. We never put our heads down. We just stayed together. I believe it's real. Especially with Jalen Green being out, which is a key piece, points that [would be] on the board that are not. We're still managing to win games. And with Kevin Porter Jr. out. I think we're even better than we're showing. We're just clicking.”

Christian Wood on Kevin Porter, Jalen Green, Dec 10, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Lonzo Ball, Kevin Porter
item.description:
Ball had knocked down a 3-pointer, but was whistled for an offensive foul on the play — presumably for initiating contact with the contesting defender, Kevin Porter Jr., after or in the process of releasing the ball.

“I was told he (Ball) shot it, he came down and fell down and kind of grabbed the guy (Porter Jr.),”

Billy Donovan on Lonzo Ball, Kevin Porter, Nov 25, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Michael Drake on Kevin Porter, Jalen Green, Josh Christopher
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Drake on the #Rockets:

“They have some great young talent. Jalen Green, special kid. Josh Christopher. Kevin Porter Jr. They got some special talents. I love that energy that is coming into the league. It’s gonna be fun to watch.”

Michael Drake on Kevin Porter, Jalen Green, Josh Christopher, Oct 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Jalen Green on Kevin Porter
item.description:
Jalen Green on his chemistry with Kevin Porter Jr:

“It’s been good. It’s not really surprising because we’re pretty much the same player in a way. Obviously he’s left handed and I’m right handed… I think we’re going to fit in real perfect together.”

Jalen Green on Kevin Porter, Oct 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Jalen Green on Kevin Porter
item.description:
Jalen Green on his relationship with Kevin Porter Jr:

“We're starting to get pretty close. I think he's super athletic. He has a great game, great IQ. I kind of match that intensity. I think it'll be a killer back court.”

Jalen Green on Kevin Porter, Jul 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Kevin Porter
item.description:
Adam Spolane:Rafael Stone on Kevin Porter Jr as a PG:

“Kevin's talented enough that he's position less. I do believe his best skill right now is passing. His court vision, his handle allows him to make plays for others that is already at a near elite level”

Rafael Stone on Kevin Porter, Jul 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @AdamSpolane.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Christian Wood, Kevin Porter
item.description:
Stephen Silas:

“I've spent a lot of time with all the guys this summer. Jae'Sean has been in most of the summer, Kevin Porter Jr has been in most of the summer. Christian Wood is in Miami, I went to visit him in Miami.”

Stephen Silas on Christian Wood, Kevin Porter, Jul 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @AdamSpolane.

item.title: Christian Wood on Kevin Porter
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Christian Wood on Kevin Porter Jr.:

“We can be both be the franchise guy. Why not? We just have to stay focused and stay together.”

Christian Wood on Kevin Porter, Apr 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Kevin Porter
item.description:
Rockets coach Stephen Silas said.

“We just felt for all three guys it’s important for them to get some games under their belt, play in our system. They’re going to be playing in the exact same system that we play here. For all three of them, this is an opportunity for one month to improve. “For (Porter,) it’s for him to get his feet wet with what we do and how we do it. And then, he hasn’t played in quite a while. So, to have consistent games night after night or every other night is important for him and his growth as far as being a part of our team.”

Stephen Silas on Kevin Porter, Jan 31, 2021. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Kevin Porter
item.description:
#Rockets HC Silas on @Kevin Porter :

“He's been great, he's been attentive. We've been doing individual stuff & today he did some team stuff. Just coming up w/ a plan that makes sense for us & for him...we needed to be smart about the plan in place for him on & off the court.”

Stephen Silas on Kevin Porter, Jan 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @AdamJWexler.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Kevin Porter
item.description:
Stephen Silas on @Kevin Porter:

“We’re still trying to work through that. He’s been here and he’s been great. He’s been attentive. We’ve been doing individual stuff with him as well as today he joined the team stuff and we’re just integrating him slowly.”

Stephen Silas on Kevin Porter, Jan 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.
